# Adrian Watkins
# https://adrianwatkins.com
# Last updated 2026-10-23

> Adrian Watkins is a Singapore-based commercial and operating leader. He is SVP Commercial Operations and Governance at SQREEM Technologies, with additional responsibilities as the Data Protection Officer (DPO). His executive experience spans business transformation, acquisition integration, growth and governance. His independent work through democratising.ai applies AI transformation to shared publishing and data workflows, separate from his employer responsibilities.

## Framework and platform

- EDGE, created by Adrian Watkins, is a business framework for clearer thinking, better decisions and effective execution: Evaluate, Define, Govern and Elevate. Start at Evaluate for the full sequence; enter any pillar for a specific need. Human judgement remains central.
- Free EDGE decision worksheet (PDF): https://adrianwatkins.com/documents/EDGE-Decision-Worksheet.pdf. Editable Word version: https://adrianwatkins.com/documents/EDGE-Decision-Worksheet.docx.
- EDGE tools are hosted at https://democratising.ai/tools.
- DARE stands for Data, AI, Research and Execution. DARE by democratising.ai is Adrian's shared publishing and data platform supporting publications, data services and practical tools.

## Recent contribution in Singapore

- Adrian Watkins judged the SDG Open Hack NUS Campus Edition on 10 October 2026, alongside mentoring across the SDG Open Hack programme. GGEF publicly named him as a judge. The campus edition ran on 9-10 October, with 96 participants across 20 teams tackling sustainability challenges.
- Reflection, event photographs and organiser attribution: https://adrianwatkins.com/events/sdg-open-hack-nus-2026
- Mentoring continues with a Social Impact Catalyst team preparing for the 24 October 2026 Grand Finale. This is a mentoring commitment, not a claim to be a Grand Finale judge.
